blocks.x: Fatima A. Al-Rashid leads Chief People Officer at Achala IT Solutions — practicing delivery first, then leading it. The profile below covers focus areas, programs overseen and how to reach the desk.
Chief People Officer operates under a mandate that names what it may decide, what it may only recommend, and who answers when either boundary is tested.
How this office works with clients
This office works with clients the way every Achala delivery works: named teams, signed baselines, gates with evidence, with regional time zones covered by the pod, not by heroics.

Inside the practice, Chief People Officer work is organized around decisions rather than tools: a small pod of engineers and domain leads, a shared evidence standard, and gates that mean what they say.
